plan.note: Gesture timing is this script's assumption, not an observation of a person.
plan.gestureGapSeconds: lognormal, median 2.0 s, clipped to 0.3-20 s
plan.pauseSeconds: 70% uniform 8-60 s; 25% uniform 60-180 s; 5% uniform 180-480 s
plan.gestureMix: 80% brush stroke (1-40 cells), 5% erase stroke, 12% rectangle fill (up to 25 x 20 cells), 3% undo of the last edit
plan.boardDwellMinutes: 8-20 minutes on one board before moving to the next of the working set
plan.manualSave: 15% of bursts end with Ctrl+S 0.3-0.9 s after the last gesture
plan.beforeRun: about 3 per hour: a run saves every dirty document with reason before-run
